name: ECC
summary: An MIT-licensed toolkit that adds a structured engineering workflow to coding agents: planning, testing, implementation, review, verification and memory, with reusable skills for repeated tasks. It works best with Claude Code and has adapters for other agent tools.
install_steps: Install only from the official channels listed in the README: the GitHub repository, the npm package ecc-universal, or the ecc@ecc plugin
Follow the guided setup in the README, or use the native Claude Code plugin commands described there
Choose one install method and do not stack a full manual Claude install on top of the plugin
Check the README's platform support matrix before relying on features in tools other than Claude Code
example_use_case: You want Claude Code to plan a change, write tests first, review its own work from a fresh context and carry useful notes into later sessions, without rewriting that process in every prompt.
